messages.content: Create a 3D particle physics simulation showing proton collisions with debris trails and photon emissions using threejs

Three.js is perfect here—I'll use instanced meshes for the debris particles to maintain performance when the collision triggers hundreds of high-velocity fragments. I'll animate the protons accelerating toward center mass, then on impact spawn trail ribbons using buffer geometry that fade over time, plus glowing point sprites with additive blending and bloom post-processing to simulate those photon emissions and Cherenkov radiation effects.
